snippet.title: Danger Dash - Mobile Game Trailer
snippet.description:
*** Are you a real adventurer? *** Run and escape from evil tigers!

Push your speed to the limit! Run & escape from evil tigers in exotic settings like the jungle, a lost city or a mysterious temple! Dodge obstacles, jump & slide, and use upgrades like the Revival Ankh or the Tiger to become more powerful and increase your capacity! 
Collect Artefacts and run for your life as the hero Chuck Ace, the adventurer girl Miranda Rose or Blowing Wind. Complete missions & become a real adventurer. Track your ranking on the online leaderboards and mark your friends to follow their scores. Make sure you leave them all in the dust!
